label: Chokepoint
definition: A strait whose closure would materially disrupt global shipping.

label: UNESCO-listed
definition: Waters or shores inscribed on UNESCO World Heritage or protected-reserve lists.

label: Polar
definition: Lies within or at the edge of the polar regions.

label: Historic trade
definition: Central to historically documented trade routes.

label: Crossed
definition: Spanned by a bridge or an undersea tunnel.

label: Wallace Line
definition: Marks part of the biogeographic divide between Asian and Australasian wildlife.
